description: Trigger evals for /rite-pressure-test — user-invocable utility that pressure-tests a rough idea by diverging into 3-5 genuinely different options, then converging on one with the trade-off and the decision's hinge.

queries.text: /rite-pressure-test
ideate with me on this
refine this idea before I commit to it
stress-test my plan
I have a vague idea — can you push on it?
queries.rationale: Description names 'I have a vague idea'.

queries.text: diverge then converge on three approaches for this
the concept is still rough — give me genuinely different options
queries.rationale: Rough concept + multiple options = pressure-test's purpose.

queries.text: I'm torn between 3-5 ways to approach this, which one and why
queries.rationale: Diverge into options + pick one with rationale matches output shape.

queries.text: what are the radically different shapes this feature could take
I don't even know what I want yet — help me explore
give me the hinge of the decision between option A and option B
queries.rationale: Decision hinge is in the output shape.

queries.text: before I spec this, I want to make sure the direction is right
write the spec for this feature
queries.rationale: Writing the actual spec is /rite-spec, not pressure-test.

queries.text: I'm picking between two near-identical variations — just choose one
plan the next slice
implement the next slice
prototype a UI to play with
queries.owner_rationale: Throwaway prototyping is /rite-prototype. The functional owner is explicit-only, so natural language has no implicit owner.

queries.text: interview me about my requirements
queries.rationale: 1-Q-at-a-time underspec extraction is devrites-interview, not idea exploration.

queries.text: review the diff against the spec
What time is it?
queries.rationale: Off-topic; no DevRites skill should fire.
queries.owner_rationale: Off-topic; no DevRites skill should fire.
